name: Nina White
evidence: No address retrieved, and a live namesake risk. GitHub code search for "Nina White" + cardiff.ac.uk confirmed the right person exists in Cardiff NLP -- asahi417.github.io publications list her on "How Are Metaphors Processed by Language Models? The Case of Analogies" (CoNLL 2024), nedjmaou.github.io lists her in the BLEnD author block (arXiv 2406.09948), and the Robust Hate Speech Detection paper thanks her for annotation -- but every hit prints only her co-authors' addresses (pilehvarmt@, camachocolladosj@, AntypasD@, CamachoColladosJ@ cardiff.ac.uk), never hers. One WebSearch ("Nina White" Cardiff University NLP BLEnD email) returned no address and, critically, the Cardiff/ResearchGate "Nina White" it did surface is in the School of Biosciences working on molecular ecology -- a different person. A Cardiff staff page https://profiles.cardiff.ac.uk/research-staff/whiten8 appeared in results but cardiff.ac.uk is blocked by the container egress policy, so it could not be opened and cannot be attributed to the NLP Nina White. Constructing a whiteN@cardiff.ac.uk-style address is forbidden, so: not found.
